title: The watch screen log sends more than its switch says
what: The switch says the log holds only screen on, off and dim times and the watch's Battery Saver and screen settings. The log that is sent also carries the watch app's version, the last choice on the watch update pop-up, the phone model and the sender's id.
expected: The switch's words list everything that is sent, or only the listed things are sent.
how_often: every time the watch log is sent
fix_line: Add the version, phone model and update note to the switch's words

title: With workout sounds off, the alert check-up asks the member to turn a sound back on
what: With Workout sounds off, Rest is over only buzzes. If Android stops that buzz, the check-up row says Android muted Rest is over and asks the member to turn its sound back on. That alert has no sound on purpose; what is missing is the buzz.
expected: With Workout sounds off, the row asks the member to turn the buzz (vibration) back on.
how_often: only with Workout sounds off and the buzz turned off in Android
fix_line: Say 'turn its vibration back on' when Workout sounds are off
